name: Can an ADU go above a garage in these cities?

mainEntity.name: Can an ADU be built above an existing garage in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, or Burbank, and what zoning issues matter most?
mainEntity.text: Can an ADU be built above an existing garage in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, or Burbank, and what zoning issues matter most?

acceptedAnswer.text: An ADU over a garage can be a smart way to preserve yard space, but it is not a simple yes-or-no question. The design still has to satisfy setbacks, height limits, structure separation, and access requirements. Burbank’s guidance specifically notes that an ADU built on top of a garage or accessory structure still requires the 4-foot rear and side-yard setback. Other cities in the area may allow similar concepts but still impose their own objective standards. Coordination matters because the garage is already an existing structure, and adding living space above it can create issues with eaves, roof height, stairs, fire separation, and privacy. Before pursuing this option, the site should be checked for structural capacity and zoning compliance together, since one can affect the other. It is often one of the most efficient ADU types when the parcel is tight, but it should be verified early.
